title: Hosting is not capturing: an exposure-capability framework and Hungary's electric-vehicle battery bet
abstract: arXiv:2610.37445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How should a dependent economy respond when a polycrisis turns economic integration from a source of efficiency into a surface of vulnerability? This paper develops the exposure-capability framework, which maps a country's strategic options along two dimensions - the concentration of its external dependence and the depth of its productive capability - and yields four ideal strategies. It applies the framework to Hungary's large-scale bet on electric-vehicle battery manufacturing, asking what the concentrated exposure purchased: movement toward a higher position in the battery value chain, as a catch-up gamble, or the reproduction of the country's existing position under a new product, as dependent entrenchment. Using a firm-level panel of Hungary's largest companies for 2010-2024, it tests four hypotheses and examines the conditions attached to the support that financed the investments. translated_title: 承接不等于获取：一个“暴露-能力”框架与匈牙利的电动汽车电池豪赌
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.37445v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当多重危机使经济一体化从效率之源转变为脆弱性之表时，一个依赖型经济体应如何应对？本文提出了“暴露-能力”框架，该框架沿两个维度——外部依赖的集中度与生产能力的深度——绘制一国的战略选择图，并由此得出四种理想型战略。本文将该框架应用于匈牙利在电动汽车电池制造领域的大规模押注，追问这种集中暴露究竟换来了什么：是向电池价值链更高位置的攀升（追赶式豪赌），还是在新产品之下复制该国既有地位（依赖性固化）。本文利用2010-2024年匈牙利最大企业的企业层面面板数据，检验了四个假设，并考察了为投资提供资金的支持政策所附加的条件。该行业已经大规模扩张，但其价值（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“暴露-能力”分析框架，并以匈牙利押注电动汽车电池制造为例，揭示承接他国产业投资并不等于真正获取价值链高位——通过2010-2024年企业面板数据检验，匈牙利的大规模集中暴露究竟是追赶跃升的豪赌还是依赖地位的固化，取决于其生产能力能否深化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an "exposure-capability" framework and applies it to Hungary's electric-vehicle battery bet, arguing that hosting foreign production is not the same as capturing value, and uses firm-level panel data (2010-2024) to test whether such concentrated exposure constitutes a catch-up gamble or dependent entrenchment.
